question: Sulochana learned the intricacies of the craft under the guidance of:
solution:
The correct answer is **'Bhalki Pendharkar'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage mentions, *"Sulochana started her career with Bhalji Pendharkar’s Sasurrvas (1946)."* This line indicates that Sulochana learned the intricacies of the craft under the guidance of **Bhalji Pendharkar, making option 4 the correct answer.**
 
• Explanation of other options:
 
 
• **Incorrect (Option 1): Badal Sirkar **- There is no mention of Sulochana Latkar learning under the guidance of Badal Sirkar in the passage.
 
• **Incorrect (Option 2): Mahesh Dattani **- There is no mention of Sulochana Latkar learning under the guidance of Mahesh Dattani in the passage.
 
• **Incorrect (Option 3): Vijay Tendulkar **- There is no mention of Sulochana Latkar learning under the guidance of Vijay Tendulkar in the passage. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, **option 4, Bhalji Pendharkar,** is the correct answer as it aligns with the information provided in the passage.
